verdict.line: You lose if you trade into her charged W or let her dash a minion for free; you win if you flank her E-range fights with a minion on the far side of you.

brief.thesis: Irelia's only gap-closer is Q (Bladesurge), and it only refreshes if the target is Marked or dies — so once she dashes onto you or a creep without a kill, she is stuck in your Facebreaker range for a full 10/9/8/7/6s with no way out. The matchup's 55.7% win rate over 3108 games comes from forcing that exact dash and then flanking her with a minion so your E stuns instead of just slows.

theirWindow.when: Her E (Flawless Duet) is up at 850 range
theirWindow.what: If both blades converge on you she gets a stun and a Mark, and that Mark lets her next Q refresh on hit for a free follow-up dash. Stay out of the 850 corridor when she has wave priority to throw it.

yourWindow.when: Her Q (Bladesurge) just hit you or a minion
yourWindow.what: Without a Mark or kill it does not refresh, so her dash is down for its full cooldown and she has no gap-closer to disengage. All-in immediately with Q (Knuckle Down) for the max-health bonus on your next two hits.

start.why: 55.8% win rate over 3439 games (88.9% pick) — the lifesteal and damage keep you ahead in the repeated short trades this lane forces.

boots.why: 55.5% win rate over 2825 games (78.2% pick) — flattens the auto-attack poke she stacks up through Ionian Fervor once her spells land.

core.why: Gives you the burst of damage and the slow to actually stick a flanked E stun or finish a trade she tries to Q out of.
Core of the 63.4% win rate path over 467 games — the shred keeps your Haymaker and autos relevant as she builds armor off your early pressure.
Caps the highest-win-rate path (63.4%, 20.9% pick) — the max-health scaling and sustain let you out-grind her sustained Q-heal lane.

runes.keystoneWhy: Both top rune pages for this matchup run it — the stacking adaptive force rewards the sustained melee trading this lane turns into once you land a flank stun.

summoners.why: 92.1% pick rate at 55.9% win rate — this lane has a real solo-kill advantage for you, and Ignite closes out the all-ins her Q-heal would otherwise let her survive.

playing.title: Bait her Q into a minion
playing.detail: Bladesurge only refreshes if the target is Marked or dies, so if she dashes a creep instead of you, her gap-closer is down for the full cooldown with nothing to show for it.

playing.title: Flank before you E
playing.detail: Facebreaker only stuns when enemies are caught on opposite sides of you; without a minion on the far side it merely slows her, so hold the cast until the wave gives you that angle.

playing.title: Bank Haymaker through her all-in
playing.detail: W stores every hit you take as Grit with no listed cap, so absorb her charged W swing and pop Haymaker right after for the true-damage center hit and shield.

playing.title: Punish the committed Q
playing.detail: The instant she dashes into your zone and whiffs the reset, all-in with Q (Knuckle Down) — the bonus max-health damage on your next two hits is at its best right when she has no escape.

playing.title: Don't trade into a visible W charge
playing.detail: Defiant Dance reduces the physical damage she takes while charging, so step out rather than swinging into it; punish the recovery after the hit lands instead.

playing.title: Hold R until you're already close
playing.detail: The Show Stopper only reaches 400 range, well inside her 850-range E, so you need to have already closed distance before you commit it — it is not a tool for engaging from range.

brief.patchCaveat: The build order, boots, runes, and all win-rate/pick-rate figures above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch; the ability readings, timing windows, and tactical calls are my own analysis layered on top of that data.
